key.name: enabled
key.description: When off, Ari's model and tools stop and nothing is asked of her. Administrators can lock this key with dconf to keep assistants off a managed machine.

key.name: approval-mode
key.summary: When Ari asks before making a change
key.description: "system": before changes that reach past your own desktop, such as the time zone or Wi-Fi. "all": before every change. "never": she does not ask, except for anything destructive or security-sensitive, which always asks.
